finding.comment: the gate slurps the JSONL into an array first, so all(.[]; .success) evaluates over the records as intended

files.patch:
--- a/ci/report_gate.sh
+++ b/ci/report_gate.sh
@@ -2,3 +2,5 @@
 # build results arrive as JSONL (one object per line):
 #   jq -c '.builds[]' <<<"$payload" >>"$records_file"
+jq -s 'all(.[]; .success)' <"$records_file" >/dev/null
+echo "all builds succeeded"
